smoke_benchmark.environment: single process, two file-backed SQLite DBs, warm sequential local-container storage, no network/broker

qualification.localDatabase: SQLite WAL, synchronous=FULL, BEGIN IMMEDIATE; operation/resource-intent/outbox/evidence journal are one local transaction
qualification.remoteDatabase: Separate SQLite transaction with its own current permission revision and tenant/objective fence checks; idempotency key; independent read connection
tested: Local failure injection at operation/resource/outbox writes
Read-grant expiry, revocation, principal and scope binding
Remote pre-commit failure and post-commit lost acknowledgement
Remote idempotency replay and changed-digest conflict
Close/reopen durability and two-connection writer-lock behavior
Append-only receipt revocation evidence and hash-chain tamper detection
not_tested: Process kill at arbitrary storage instructions or physical power loss
PostgreSQL isolation/replication, multi-host consensus, brokers or real HTTP services
Concurrent multi-process stress/linearizability beyond the writer-lock test
Production authentication, PKI/key lifecycle, live source attestations; source receipt issuer_id in fixture is trusted test data
Industry-equivalent throughput or production SLO; local sequential benchmark only
Privileged whole-database rewrite detection without an external chain-head anchor

core_invariant: The local objective operation, resource intent, outbox event and causally ordered evidence journal commit or roll back together; source receipts and revocations are append-only evidence; remote effects are separately idempotent and independently read back; lost acknowledgement remains outcome_unknown until same-key reconciliation. No distributed atomicity is claimed.

source.qualification: 38 deterministic SQLite preflight cases plus five separate-process local smoke benchmark repetitions; no Rust, PostgreSQL, broker, network, real sink or production authentication executed.
source.published_artifact_note: Source is stored as deterministic gzip so its exact tested UTF-8 bytes can be reconstructed; run the decompressed stream directly through Node.

benchmark_interpretation: The throughput values are local, warm, sequential SQLite cycles over two databases on one container host. They are not comparable to DBOS published throughput or production systems; no equivalent hardware, workload, network, persistence semantics or concurrency has been matched.
